audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 contradict the page's own prose. Levels 2 and 3 are marked Ornn while whys[2] says 'you win nearly every trade now'; 4-5 and 6 are marked Skill while the mid text calls them 'your window' and level 6 'the whole matchup'; first item is marked Ornn while whys[5] says 'force the all-in here'.

audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Nautilus in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them; row 6 stays Ornn.

audit.why: Spikes: your level 2-3 pattern, level 6 Depth Charge, first-item all-in, and Ornn's late scaling. Correct ladder; only the chart disagreed with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls the magma pillar 'his E pillar' in three places. The pillar comes from Volcanic Rupture (Q) — a 800-range fissure on a 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown that slows and then forms the pillar. Searing Charge (E) is a 450-range charge that only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain.
audit.why: This is the decisive sequencing of the matchup and the page has it backwards. Ornn cannot knock you up on open ground: he needs a wall, or he needs his own Q pillar to charge into. Stand away from terrain and off his pillar and Searing Charge is a body-check with no CC.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture (Q) makes the pillar; Searing Charge (E) only knocks up on terrain collision, so his own pillar is the wall he needs. Bellows Breath (W) is what applies Brittle.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — Ornn's E pillar and W brittle trade with your auto-passive and you have no all-in without W or E yet.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — Volcanic Rupture and Bellows Breath trade with your auto-passive and you have no all-in yet.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even — Ornn's E pillar and W can trade and his brittle shatter respects your walk-up, so don't throw a naked Q before you have W. The moment you hit 2 and especially 3 with Q, W and E online you take over: hook him off the wave, eat the passive root proc, and pop W to burn magic damage onto him through every short trade. He has no sustain whatsoever, so every chunk sticks. Just respect his E pillar — if he lands it on you mid-engage he knocks you up and brittle-shatters your follow-up, so bait the pillar before you commit Q.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely even — Volcanic Rupture and Bellows Breath can trade and Brittle respects your walk-up, so don't throw a naked hook before you have W. The moment you hit 2 and especially 3 with Q, W and E online you take over: hook him off the wave, eat the passive root proc, and pop Titan's Wrath to burn him through every short trade. He has no sustain, so every chunk sticks. Respect the pillar itself — Searing Charge only knocks up when he hits terrain, so his own Q pillar is the wall he needs. Stand off it and his E is just a shove.

notes: The page had Ornn's magma pillar on the wrong ability in three places: Volcanic Rupture (Q) creates the pillar, and Searing Charge (E) only knocks up when it collides with terrain — his own pillar included. Chart rows 1-5 flipped to Nautilus in both layers as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the page's own prose.
